sections.heading: 1. Before you go
lines: ① Use a running pram; check its age guide.
② Wrist strap on, light grip on the handle.
③ Run tall, pram close to your body.
④ Start with 1 min jog, 1 min walk × 10.

caption:
Weekend mornings, Lulu runs with the pram. It feels much harder on the back and shoulders than running solo.

Hunching over and leaning on the handle can load the back and shoulders. First, check the pram is designed for running and follow the maker's age guidance. Wrist strap on, light grip, run tall and keep the pram close. Start with 1 minute jogging, 1 minute walking, 10 rounds, and build up slowly.

Pain that makes you limp, pain that builds run to run, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
